From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated scores + suggested decision for Elena Morales

Team — thanks for getting these in quickly. I pulled the numeric rubric and put an aggregated view in the folder (see linked Drive doc). Summary below:

Aggregated rubric (avg):
- System Design: 3.7
- Code Quality: 4.0
- Ownership & Signals: 4.7
- Culture fit: 4.3
Overall: 4.2

Recommendations from reviewers: Jonas — Hire; Mina — Hire with mentorship; Priyom — Hold for a technical take-home or short pairing session before a firm offer.

My read: Elena is a strong cross-functional candidate with particularly high ownership signals and product sense. The only sticking point is distributed systems depth on multi-tenant isolation and edge cases; that could be validated quickly with a 90-minute pairing session (pair on a small design + code kata) or an expedited take-home with a 48-hour turnaround.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) Schedule a 90-minute pair with Jonas next week (preferred) and send a soft offer contingent on pair outcomes.
2) Send a short take-home (48h) focused on tenant isolation patterns; move to offer if pass.
3) If team wants to skip technical validation, extend an offer at a slightly lower starting band with a 3-month mentorship plan.

Please reply with your preferred option and whether we should include compensation guidance now. If no objections by 5pm PT, I'll move forward with option 1 and ask Marissa to tentatively hold an offer template.

Quoted for context:
> Mina Haddad: Hire (mentorship) — strong behavioral fit.
> Jonas Weber: Hire — confident in product + engineering fit.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Hiring Manager, Core Services

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

All — thanks, Priyom. I agree option 1 is the fastest and keeps candidate momentum. I'll:
- Tentatively block Jonas's calendar for a 90-minute pairing slot next Tue/Wed.
- Draft a soft verbal offer outline (band, start window) and hold it pending pair outcome.
- Send a short scheduling note to Elena (cc'd) proposing times and a note about the pairing session purpose.

Action items: Jonas — can you confirm availability for Tue/Wed morning PT? Priyom — I'll prepare the offer stub (salary band + equity range) once you confirm we want to proceed.

Marissa
